info.title: Flyflor Socket Wire API
info.description: Apifox-importable contract for Flyflor's socket vascular layer. The current transport is WebSocket at /ws plus GET /health. The flyflor.ws.v1 wire keeps gateway.* message names for v1 compatibility; those names are not the architecture subject and do not imply session/chat continuity. history.list reads brain.db as a ledger/query/replay/audit plane only; it is not prompt or context assembly. conversationKey and user.id are provenance/routing fields only. Context assembly comes from current input, MemoryComponent recall, CrystalComponent recall, explicit activeScope/contextForkId, and the visible Executive capability surface.

x-apifox-scenarios.name: Real socket live turn
x-apifox-scenarios.description: GET /health, connect Apifox WebSocket to /ws, receive server.hello, send client.hello, read status/catalog/history, send gateway.message.send, then observe turn.delta and turn.final.

x-apifox-scenarios.name: Turn metadata surfaces
x-apifox-scenarios.description: Render turn.final.reply.metadata.ask, planning, and executiveToolLoop from the examples without treating event timeline frames as turn-final authority.

x-apifox-scenarios.name: Invalid payload
x-apifox-scenarios.description: Send gateway.message.send with an empty payload and expect a flyflor.ws.v1 error envelope with code invalid-payload.

get.description: Returns process health without invoking runtime thinking, memory, Crystal, Scope, or ledger replay.

Upgrades to the flyflor.ws.v1 socket protocol. Apifox should connect to ws://127.0.0.1:8788/ws and exchange the message examples in this contract as raw JSON WebSocket messages. The connection clientId is a live transport peer id only; it is not a user/session/chat continuity owner.

101.description: Switching Protocols. After upgrade the server sends server.hello.

400.description: Authorized upgrade was attempted, but the underlying WebSocket upgrade failed.

401.description: Non-local upgrade without a valid control token.

503.description: Socket control hub is not ready.

get.x-flyflor-wire-compat: gateway.* names are preserved for flyflor.ws.v1 compatibility only.

payload.description: Payload shape depends on type. Required for gateway.message.send and history.list, optional for client.hello, gateway.status.get, capability.catalog.get, event.subscribe, event.unsubscribe and ping.

SocketEnvelope.description: Control envelope for flyflor.ws.v1. Runtime event broadcasts use SocketEventEnvelope with flyflor.event.v1; event.publish is not a ws control message type.

clientId.description: Live transport peer id only. It is not a user/session/chat continuity owner.

ClientHelloPayload.description: Optional client hello metadata. The server currently acknowledges it without using it for cognitive continuity or connection identity changes.

cache.description: Short-lived socket read-cache stats for TUI diagnostics. The cache only covers read-only control/query snapshots.

clientCount.description: Live socket peer count, not a channel count or continuity owner.

contextWindowTokens.description: Authoritative model context window from explicit config or a provider/model known mapping. Null means the kernel only knows the generation cap.

maxOutputTokens.description: Configured generation output cap from model.maxTokens. This is not the model context window.

compressionThresholdTokens.description: Configured compression threshold when the gateway has a real source. Null means unknown.

contextWindowPercent.description: hotContextTokens / model.contextWindowTokens when both values are known; otherwise null.

hotContextTokens.description: Current hot-context token estimate when the gateway has a real source. Null means the CLI should estimate locally.

remainingContextTokens.description: model.contextWindowTokens - hotContextTokens when both values are known; otherwise null.

ControlStateSnapshot.description: Socket-owned live read model fed by real turn.final metadata and RuntimeEvent payloads. This is not a session owner and does not assemble prompt context.

HistoryListPayload.description: Required payload for history.list. This is a brain.db ledger query/replay/audit surface, not a session restore, prompt container, or context assembly input.

ForkCreatePayload.description: State-changing control payload for fork.create. Socket validates the wire input, then calls the injected RuntimeModule.createContextFork boundary; query/read-model commands remain read-only.

MessageSendPayload.description: Required payload for gateway.message.send. payload.text is mandatory; route/user/thread fields are transport provenance only and do not create cognitive continuity.

conversationKey.description: Routing/audit/dedup/reply-anchor key only. Not a Scope, session, memory owner, or cognitive continuity source.

threadId.description: Platform lane/reply metadata only. Not a Scope/Fork or cognitive continuity source.

id.description: External actor provenance only. user.id is not a cognitive continuity owner.

RuntimeContextInput.description: Explicit context entry. Flyflor does not infer Scope/Fork from connection, user, chat, thread, conversationKey, or history query fields; current turn context assembly remains current input + MemoryComponent + CrystalComponent + explicit Scope/Fork + Executive visible capability surface.

contextForkId.description: Explicit ContextFork id. It is accepted only when provided by the client or runtime metadata, not inferred from natural language or transport ids.

RuntimeToolApprovals.description: Explicit one-turn tool approval bridge for trusted local WS/TUI clients. These flags only install approval callbacks for this gateway.message.send turn; they do not change sandbox policy, config, catalog visibility, or future turns.

mcpToolCalls.description: When true, approve MCP-compatible runtime tool calls for this turn after the normal catalog, schema, Executive, and sandbox gates.

userToolCalls.description: When true, approve user-manifest tool calls for this turn after the normal catalog, schema, Executive, and sandbox gates.

SocketClientEnvelope.description: Inbound client control frames. Use this schema in Apifox when validating client-to-server WS messages; send the example value as the raw WebSocket body. gateway.message.send and history.list require payload objects.

QueryPayload.description: Read-only DB query payload. Query commands inspect persisted brain.db, blackboard DB, scope.db, or crystal.db state only; they do not invoke runtime thinking or prompt/context assembly.

data.description: Query result. List commands return arrays; detail commands return an object or null.
